verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management and cap-table SaaS. Consuming MCP servers is the role of an AI agent or assistant host, and nothing in the evidence shows Ledgy offers any agent or assistant feature that could plug in external tools. The evidence covers only its OAuth-authenticated data API (auth, companyCaptable, companyTransactions) and its equity, reporting and trading features, so the MCP-client axis does not apply to this kind of product.
